independentChecks.flipDp: Second implementation: one generic corner DP applied to row/column-flipped grids; equals oracle on all brute grids, 150 random grids up to 45x45, and every authored extra including 1000x1000 (unit test).

Statement-level definition, no interior/orientation assumption. Checked on 500 fixed-seed random grids with 3<=n,m<=6 (oracle and flip DP), every official test and sample, and every authored extra with n*m<=42 (unit test).

officialReview.note: All 10 included official CRLF pairs and the sample parse within constraints and match both the oracle and the exhaustive path-pair brute. No malformed upstream pair or contradiction among supplied pairs. The 19 open-r1 generated tests are not in the input row and were not reviewed here; parent review() over the package will check them.

oracle: Four O(nm) corner DPs (TL->cell, cell->BR, BL->cell, cell->TR); answer = max over 2<=i<=n-1, 2<=j<=m-1 of max(TL[i-1][j]+BR[i+1][j]+BL[i][j-1]+TR[i][j+1], TL[i][j-1]+BR[i][j+1]+BL[i+1][j]+TR[i-1][j]). Max answer 10^5*(2(n+m-1)-2)=399600000 fits 32-bit.
parse: Line 1 exactly "n m" with 3<=n,m<=1000; exactly n further lines of exactly m tokens matching 0|[1-9][0-9]* separated by single spaces, each <=10^5. LF or CRLF line endings, optional single final terminator. Rejects signs, underscores, leading zeros, tabs, padding, blank/extra/missing lines, flattened or split rows.

semantics: First line n m (3<=n,m<=1000); then exactly n lines of m integers a[i][j], 0<=a[i][j]<=10^5 (public English statement shows 10<sup>5</sup>; pinned row flattened it to 105 and official test values 100000 confirm 10^5). Iahub walks (1,1)->(n,m) moving down/right, Iahubina walks (n,1)->(1,m) moving up/right; their paths share exactly one cell, which neither counts. Unique integer: maximum total of all other visited cells. The shared cell is necessarily interior (2<=i<=n-1, 2<=j<=m-1) and the paths cross it orthogonally, so answer = max over interior cells and both crossing orientations of four corner path DPs. Exhaustive enumeration of all path pairs with exactly one common cell cross-checks small grids; a flip-based second DP and reconstructed witness paths cross-check large ones.
